newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish bond market ended slightly higher, frightened again late on Tuesday evening after Bundesbank council member Helmut Hesse said a delay in launching the European single currency would force the Maastricht Treaty to be renegotiated and ratified by member states.
"Friday's fears are back. It's the first time a Bundesbank member seems to be considering the possibility of a delay in the EMU project," said Valentin Fernandez at Credit Lyonnais.
The long-term future contract closed 16 basis points higher at 112.29, after having touched a high at 112.74 basis points, with a 10-year spread over Bunds at around 136 basis points.
